summary:
Integer overflow sizing the float remap buffer in
libavcodec/ffv1enc_vulkan.c (CVE range "9.0 through 9.0.2"). The Vulkan
FFV1 encoder does not exist in 7.1.5 (no ffv1enc_vulkan.c).
Refs:
  - https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-125248
  - https://code.ffmpeg.org/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/f2e94c3ebaf04c7cb55d3ea5e5b13d3600a5eec3
